summary: Reviewed GE Vernova after its 2026-07-28 lower-Bollinger transition. The USD 946 close fell 14.20% over the observation period and finished 1.02% below the lower band, but RSI was not oversold and volume was not abnormal. Current SEC-filed Q2 evidence still shows strong Power and Electrification orders, backlog, margins, cash and raised guidance, with no new fundamental impairment explaining the July 28 leg down. Re-marking the unchanged bounded 12-month valuation gives 39.6% downside and 7.4% base upside, so the move is post-results valuation/timing risk rather than a sufficient paper-trade opportunity. Retained medium-confidence baseline eligibility, created no conviction strategy, and enqueued exactly one dependent refresh for the accepted AI-infrastructure idea.

evidence.claim: The unchanged July 22 release reports USD 24.2 billion of Q2 orders, USD 176 billion of backlog, USD 11.1 billion of revenue, USD 5.1 billion of free cash flow, and raised 2026 revenue and free-cash-flow guidance. It confirms operating strength through the latest reported quarter and does not establish a new fundamental impairment behind the July 28 price decline.

The unchanged SEC filing confirms USD 13.120 billion of cash and restricted cash, USD 2.794 billion of long-term borrowings, 270 million Q2 diluted weighted-average shares, working-capital dependence, backlog-quality terms, acquisition exposure, and Wind execution risk. These inputs support the bounded valuation and preserve the principal contrary evidence.
